meta.name: offensive-jwt
meta.description: JWT attack methodology for penetration testers. Covers algorithm confusion (alg:none, RS256→HS256), weak HMAC secret brute force, kid parameter injection (SQLi, path traversal), jku/x5u/jwk header injection, JWKS cache poisoning, JWS/JWE confusion, timing attacks, and mobile JWT storage extraction. Use when testing JWT-based authentication, hunting auth bypass via token manipulation, or evaluating JWT implementation security in web or mobile apps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会指导你测试 JWT 认证的安全性，包括算法混淆、弱密钥破解、kid 注入、JWK/JKU 注入、缓存投毒、时序攻击等，并给出手动和自动测试步骤。
howto.when: 当你需要测试基于 JWT 的认证系统、寻找令牌操纵导致的认证绕过漏洞，或评估 Web/移动应用中 JWT 实现的安全性时触发。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through testing JWT authentication security, including algorithm confusion, weak secret brute force, kid injection, JWK/JKU injection, cache poisoning, timing attacks, and provide manual and automated testing steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to test JWT-based authentication, hunt for auth bypass via token manipulation, or evaluate JWT implementation security in web or mobile apps.

say_en.text: Help me test this JWT token for algorithm confusion vulnerability.
